summary: Depth-first rabbithole dossier for App Services Schema Validation; source-anchored research pack.

facts.text: [low] An Atlas App Services log message of the form 'role ... does not have update permission for document ...: could not validate document: departureLocation.geoLocation.coordinates.1: Invalid type' was reported when schema validation rejected an integer where a double was expected; the cause was the type mismatch, not a missing permission. Sources: https://github.com/realm/realm-js/issues/6219

[low] MongoDB Atlas App Services may exhibit a bug where JSON numbers are treated as integers, causing schema validation failures for fields expecting specific types. Sources: https://github.com/realm/realm-js/issues/6219

[low] A user reported that Realm still throws exceptions for 'int' and 'double' types, which they attributed to NodeJS converting values to the smallest possible type; a MongoDB engineer instead attributed the issue to App Services treating the JSON number 1 as an integer. Sources: https://github.com/realm/realm-js/issues/6219
